lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: She's been awake for twenty minutes. Hasn't moved. Hasn't checked her gear. She already checked it before she lay down.
lines.lens: Rynn's bedroll positioned two meters from the tree line. Knife within arm's reach, pack straps loosened for quick shouldering. She planned her exit before she ever closed her eyes.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: You always sit facing southeast on watch.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: It is. I just didn't think anyone else would know that without a compass.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: You re-tied the lean-to knots before sundown.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: Wind was shifting. Would've held, but I don't like 'would've.'

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: That's the thing about Rynn. She doesn't wait for problems to announce themselves. She reads the air the way I read a room.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.text: You want tea? I set water near the coals before I turned in. Should be warm by now.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: The path you cleared this afternoon. Southeast through the ferns.
lines.lens: Not a foraging trail. She cut it wide enough for all five of us moving fast. Loose branches removed so no one trips in the dark.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.monologue: She doesn't say thank you. Neither do I. We don't need to.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Go back to sleep. I've got this.
